description: Set breakpoints in a GDScript file, replacing any previously set in that file. Returns: each breakpoint with whether Godot verified it and the line it bound to. IMPORTANT: lines are ZERO-BASED, matching every other tool here. Set these before running the game, then use debug_stack_trace and debug_inspect once execution stops.

lines.description: Zero-based line numbers. Pass [] to clear all breakpoints in the file.

name: debug_set_breakpoints
